findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_ad, watchlist_webhook · Private data: watchlist_webhook · Public sink: search_winners, get_facts, watchlist_webhook, search_experiments · Destructive: search_winners, get_ad, watchlist_edit, get_brand, get_weights.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_ad, watchlist_webhook · Private data: watchlist_webhook · Public sink: search_winners, get_facts, watchlist_webhook, search_experiments · Destructive: search_winners, get_ad, watchlist_edit, get_brand, get_weights

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
